_what: Read-only copies of outside repositories, fetched into mirrors/<name>/ (gitignored) by the mirrors skill (fetch_mirrors.py). Entries with "commit" are pinned; entries with "follow": true take the newest commit of "ref" on every fetch; "kind": "pages" entries copy the .md pages a site's llms.txt links, always current. Cite files as mirrors/<name>/<path> or mirrors/<set>/<member>/<path>.
